descriptions.value: 本片由香港导演许鞍华执导，改编自著名小说家张爱玲的同名小说，是一个发生在日军入侵香港期间的爱情故事。一个内向的上海离婚女子和一个愤世嫉俗的马来西亚花花公子互相倾慕。但因时局动荡，两人多次被迫分开，最终能否有情人终成眷属?

titles.value: 混世四猴：神猴归来 / The Monkey is Back

descriptions.value: 救世主灵明石猴曾赐予绝望女孩生存的希望，并许下守护终生的承诺。不料多年后，他与傲慢的三眼战神展开一场毁天灭地的大战，最终惨遭击败，金身碎裂堕入凡尘。失去神力的石猴，究竟能否重燃斗志，打破命运枷锁，再度归来履行当年对女孩许下的誓言？
当年轻母亲为女儿莫名失踪而苦恼时，一连串怪异的事件接踵而至。这都可能与二十年前的意外亡魂为复仇归来有关…
艳丽女模余虹敏在一间盛传闹鬼的废弃医院中离奇身亡。事后，她生前的摄影师不断接到如怨灵索命般的诡异来电，合作撰稿人突遭严重车祸，而她的挚友亦突然离奇失踪。一连串毛骨悚然的怪事接踵而来，彷佛死者充满妒恨的怨魂，正在黑暗中展开疯狂报复。
前特警队长东谷在任务中罹患永久性失明，之后更被胁迫要承担任务失败的责任。幸好东谷在女儿的陪伴下逐渐走出阴霾，并开始适应黑暗的世界。可是曾经的宿敌再度出现，令女儿陷入危险之中。东谷为救女儿，展开了一场生死盲战。

titles.value: 鬼马飞人 / The Flying Mr. B

descriptions.value: 阿B为一名中学的体育教师，其执教之学校篮、足球队成绩甚差，学校下令他务必赢得校际比赛冠军，否则将撤换教练。阿B因头痛，误服同事研制之神药，变成超人，令球队屡次创造奇迹...

titles.value: 逃学威龙三之龙过鸡年 / Fight Back to School III

descriptions.value: 富商王百万被发现离奇死于酒店房间，由于周星星与他极为相似，星星再次接受任务，作卧底调查这宗谋杀案。王百万生前与妻子感情早已破裂，妻子因此成为头号嫌疑人。然而，在调查过程中，星星发现王百万的友人林大岳同样形迹可疑……
曾经叱咤世界拳坛的拳王程辉，在澳门遇见了热血青年思齐。随着他训练思齐备战即将举行的混合格斗赛，程辉不仅重燃了对拳击的热爱，还重新找回了对生命的热情，并更加珍惜那些在生命中真正重要的人。

titles.value: 龙的传人 / Legend Of The Dragon

descriptions.value: 青年周小龙离开纯朴的离岛到香港发展。他的师叔欺骗小龙参加桌球比赛，并以他父亲的地皮作为赌注。小龙最后输掉了比赛，幸得他青梅竹马的朋友毛毛鼓励，把自家的田地也作为赌注。小龙最后能否把自己的土地赢回来？

titles.value: 大魔术师 / The Great Magician

descriptions.value: 军阀雷大牛手握重兵，权倾一方，却始终无法赢得三姨太柳遥的芳心。此时，神秘魔术师张贤凭惊世古彩戏法名动京城，并受邀入雷府表演。表面卖艺的他，实则是柳遥昔日未婚夫。在这场真假难辨的奇幻博弈中，张贤暗藏着偷天换日的救人与复仇计划。
退出江湖的特工华叔，在老街以开古董店为生。一天，老街遭当地青龙帮强拆时，华叔隐藏的身份被暴露，并受到阿杰为首的神秘组织追杀，由此展开了一场双雄对决!

民国初年，富甲一方的康氏惨遭灭门，唯一的目击证人—家中的幼女—在亲眼目睹全家被杀后离奇失踪。几十年间，位于青木巷的废弃康宅充斥着灵异惊悚的气氛。随着真相逐渐揭露，这个恐怖的疑团交织着复仇与死亡的动机。

titles.value: 铁线功夫拳 / Iron Kung Fu Fist

descriptions.value: 武术宗师梁坤为保护心爱的女人毅然退隐江湖，不料他的隐忍却换来了爱人的惨死。意识到宿命避无可避，他重返武林，在丐帮帮主苏灿的鼎力相助下，梁坤杀出一条血路，誓要向那些冷血仇敌讨回血债。
这是一场发生在三国动荡时期的史诗式之旅。曹操试图招揽关羽加入他的阵营，但关羽忠于他的结拜兄弟刘备，也是曹操的敌人。当关羽试图从曹操手上救出刘备的小妾时，迫于无奈要大开杀戒。最后他能否杀出重围？

titles.value: 纸人回魂 / Get in the Dark

descriptions.value: 一位记者调查二十年前纸人回魂案时，听到三个关于恐怖纸人的故事。故事起源于乔府大小姐乔媛媛枉死后，管家请纸扎匠为小姐做了纸人陪葬。纸人被点眼睛后，大小姐得以借纸人回魂复仇，更接二连三引发连串与纸人有关的骇人听闻事件。
三名持枪劫匪抢劫了一批正在运送的新发行货币，刑警常勇奉命展开调查。随着线索逐渐浮现，常勇成功击毙一名劫匪。然而，其他两名劫匪不甘就此罢手，乘乱密谋抢劫金厂的黄金。常勇凭借精密的部署，成功粉碎了他们的计划，将不法分子绳之以法。

titles.value: 游龙戏凤 / Look for a Star

descriptions.value: 英俊潇洒的富商程仲森曾有过三段失败的婚姻。当他遇见在赌场担任荷官、闲暇时兼职舞蹈表演的米兰，两人迅速坠入爱河。然而，当他提出签署婚前协议书的那一刻，这段刚萌芽的恋情随即面临严峻考验。

titles.value: 军火大劫案 / Munitions Hijacking Case

descriptions.value: 特工阿文被安排潜伏于东南亚的军火商旗下，寻找其手中的一批军火炸药并将其销毁。当他终于找到该批军火后，却遭到不明匪徒袭击。为防止灾难发生，阿文决定与他的特工搭档阿琼合力夺回军火。

titles.value: 花心大少 / Hong Kong Playboys

descriptions.value: 严钱声是一名自恃追女高手的富家花花公子，被母亲劝喻要成家立室。他在寻找生命中的女主角时，被两个追女高手挑战。到底他最后能否找到心中最爱?

titles.value: 冰封侠之时空行者 / Iceman the Time Traveller

descriptions.value: 《冰封侠：时空行者》承接前作，四位明朝锦衣卫在现代香港苏醒。为修正历史，贺英独自踏上了寻找「时空金球」的凶险旅程，却不知自己正一步步堕入精心布下的致命陷阱。
故事描述沈元（李修贤）亡父与林亚峇（谷峰）为生死之交。沈父临终前，曾在林之背上刺有神秘图案，而此图实是一道有特殊功能的符。后林为保护女儿中月（陈萍）而杀人，被判死刑；林被处死前，着沈把图案描下，以备不时之须。沈按图文指示，化身成威力无穷的油鬼子，帮助过不少人，亦铲除不少坏人，但最终却陷入疯狂状态。

titles.value: 望夫成龙 / Love Is Love

descriptions.value: 在乡间长大的情侣石金水和吴带娣青梅竹马，但娣父反对他们在一起，于是二人搬到市区共同生活。带娣为助金水找到一份推销员工作，暗中当舞小姐为其筹款。金水因工作勤奋，受上司赏识，加以提拔。虽然工作发展如意，但金水渐渐发觉自己与带娣的距离越来越远...

titles.value: 大内密探零零发 / Forbidden City Cop

descriptions.value: 零零发是宫廷四大高手之一，专职保卫皇帝的安全。虽然不谙武功，却有着不寻常的嗜好：打造超越时代的发明。皇上被掳后，他靠着自己的过人发明救驾。
台湾女孩阿不前往香港，寻找漂流玻璃樽中那封浪漫纸条的作者阿拔。谁料现实阿拔与幻想的相差甚远，让她心碎失望、决定黯然返乡。就在命运的转角，她遇上富豪企业家陈子午，就此展开一段意想不到的爱情故事。

titles.value: 种鬼 / Seeding Of A Ghost

descriptions.value: 故事描述，出租车司机周通(高飞饰)之妻艾莲(玄智慧饰)红杏出墙，搭上赌场常客方明(徐少强饰)。一日，艾与方争执后独自离去，却被流氓挟往荒屋施暴，艾极力反抗，终堕楼惨死。周受一股神秘力量引导，发现艾尸首，蒙眬间，闻鬼语遣其往找巫师设法报仇。自始怪事接连发生，所有与艾之死有关的人均遭鬼怪缠扰...

titles.value: Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan

descriptions.value: Nunchucks. Dark shades. A yellow jumpsuit. That unmistakable nose wipe. Blinding punches and the snake feint – one name says it all: Bruce Lee, the man who brought Chinese martial arts to the world. But every legend has a beginning – and his is less well known. It started in Shunde of Foshan City, south China's Guangdong Province. Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots – following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet!

The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game "Sifu" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to "eat porridge at night"

The city of Changsha is one of central China's powerhouses. It's a leader in both the construction machinery industry and in media – Changsha was China's first UNESCO "Creative City". It's also one of China's best-known cities for its nightlife. 
The soul of a city is in its people, and this episode focuses on the women of Changsha who are helping to innovate, change and further develop this city they call home.

In this Episode, we explore dragon walls in Datong, the City of Dragon Walls, to create a new tourist trail. The host then rides a motorcycle along Datong’s Great Wall, presenting local culture and scenic spots along the way.

In this episode, we travel to Wujiang District of Suzhou City on China’s east coast to explore the birthplace of silk. There we discover that silk is not merely a precious fabric but also a way of life.
For centuries, Wujiang District has been one of China’s largest‑scale silk‑producing regions, which has turned it into a major commercial hub. Local residents worship a distinctive deity‑the Silkworm Goddess. Per the traditional Chinese lunar calendar, the Lesser Fullness of Grain (Xiaoman) solar term coincides with the goddess’s birthday. Local folk opera troupes take turns staging performances on the stage by the main temple hall over several days to mark the occasion and pray for good fortune.
We then learn how silk was manufactured centuries ago, before seeing how imperial‑grade silk is being reinvented for modern‑day fashion.

titles.value: Shunde’s Waterways: where business smarts meet everyday life

descriptions.value: Shunde, a district in Guangdong Province, lies in the Pearl River Delta, north of Hong Kong—a water-rich region that lives by water and knows how to turn it into opportunity. Once, boats carried silk down its canals from small villages, building a legacy of trade. Today, Xiangyunsha (gambiered Canton gauze) is a global fashion icon, and historic spots like Mingshi Garden draw tourists and locals alike. With water as their muse and grit as their guide, Shunde folks keep business thriving while making life sweeter—that’s the quiet wisdom flowing through their rivers. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia are setting out to explore more with the locals...

titles.value: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut

descriptions.value: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts.  He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.
